article.title: Exploited SonicWall SSL-VPN flaw lets attackers bypass SAML-enforced MFA (CVE-2026-19868)
article.summary: SonicWall has fixed an exploited SonicOS SSL-VPN vulnerability (CVE-2026-19868) that may allow attackers with valid credentials to bypass SAML-enforced multi-factor authentication. With no workarounds listed, the company has urged admins to patch quickly. About CVE-2026-19868 CVE-2026-19868 is an authentication enforcement flaw in the SonicOS SSL-VPN service, and is exploitable only if SAML is enabled for SSL-VPN logins. article.title: Hackers Exploit Qubole's Trusted AWS Access to Breach Customer Accounts and Steal Data
article.summary: An attacker broke into AWS accounts belonging to multiple Qubole customers between October 14 and October 26 and stole stored secrets and data, cloud security company Wiz said today. The attacker used credentials for an AWS account that Qubole's platform uses to reach those customers. How the attacker got those credentials has not been disclosed.
